学校のマスターを倒しても、まだ先があるかもしれないだろ。……バーサーカーっていう怪物もいるんだ。協力しあえるなら、出来るかぎり協力した方がいい」

pages.en:
“…No. I can’t say that for certain.

“Even after we defeat the school Master, others may remain. …And there is Berserker. If we can cooperate, we should continue as long as possible.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…No. I can’t say for sure yet.
There might be more to do even after we defeat the Master at my school. …There’s that monster called Berserker as well. If we can cooperate, we should cooperate for as long as we can.”

「
そうですか。マスターがそう言うのならば従いますが……それでは、シロウが辛いだけになる。その時になって、自らの選択を悔やまないでください」
それでは、と一礼してセイバーは去っていく。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“—I see. If that is my Master's decision, I will abide by it. …But you only make matters more painful for yourself. When the time comes, do not regret your choice.”

Saber bows and leaves.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
I see. I will obey if Master says so. …But that will only make it harder for you. Please do not regret your choice when the time comes.”
Saber bows and leaves.

pages.en:
To spare myself that pain, Tohsaka and I should remain enemies as much as possible.

Otherwise, all it will leave is a deep scar.

Whether I win or she does, the survivor will have to finish the other——
pages.mirrorMoon:
…I should try to be Tohsaka’s enemy for as long as I can if I don’t want to be mentally hurt.
Or else, what’s going to remain is a big scar.
Because no matter which one of us wins, the survivor has to finish off the loser
